title: Gas Safe Register UK Scraper (Parse.bot Compatible)

location.title: Location (City or Postcode)
location.description: City/town name (e.g. 'Cambridge', 'Leeds') or UK postcode (e.g. 'CB1 1JY'). Used for search_businesses.

registration_number.title: Registration Number (Optional Direct Lookup)
registration_number.description: Look up one Gas Safe registered business by registration number and return its details with every engineer (matches Parse.bot get_business_engineers). If provided, location search is skipped.

service_type.title: Service Type
service_type.description: Gas service category to search ('Domestic' or 'Commercial').

page.title: Starting Page
page.description: First listing page to read (1-indexed, 10 results per page).

max_pages.title: Max Pages
max_pages.description: Number of consecutive listing pages to fetch and combine into the response (1-25).

include_engineers.title: Include Engineers
include_engineers.description: Set to true to fetch the engineers array for each business (one extra request per business); false to leave it empty (bulk mode).

include_services.title: Include Services / Competencies Matrix
include_services.description: Scrape full domestic & commercial qualifications matrix (Natural Gas, LPG, Building Regulations) for each business.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: UK Residential Proxy configuration (essential for Incapsula anti-bot bypass).
